name: Silence, the market is talking
description: A 1-of-1 on-chain generative oracle that turns live Ethereum block activity into an ever-changing stream of language.
about:
## The piece

"Silence, the market is talking" is a single-edition (1-of-1) generative work by FelixFelixFelix. It listens to live Ethereum block activity and exhales it as language — a never-repeating stream of spoken and typed sentences whose rhythm, breadth and mood are driven by on-chain volume and flow. Everything renders on-chain, in the browser.

## Two append-only logs

The contract keeps two block-keyed logs. Each write is stored under the current block number, and `stateAt(block)` returns the value in force at any block (the value stored at the greatest block ≤ the query), so the inputs and mood can be re-derived exactly as they stood at that moment. A historical render still uses the renderer and its current provider, script and link configuration.

- **inputs** — the ERC-20 contracts the work watches, stored as one concatenated string. Written only by *the hosioi*.
- **mood** — the oracle's tone knobs, stored as one concatenated string. Written only by *the prophet*.

## Roles

- **The hosioi** ("the holy ones") are addresses the owner appoints via `setHosioi`; they alone set the watched inputs and the RPC provider defaults the live piece reads chain over.
- **The prophet** is whoever currently holds the unique token; the holder alone sets the mood. Transferring the token passes the role on.

At genesis the watched inputs were the ApeCoin (APE), Maker (MKR), The Graph (GRT) and Ethereum Name Service (ENS) token contracts, but this set is hosioi-mutable and may change over time.

## Renderer

Metadata and HTML are produced by a separate renderer contract, `TheMarketIsTalkingRenderer` (`0x0bdc00fe1d7924dd5893b092b7ed0e3abccecef5`). `tokenURI` and `tokenHTML` delegate to it, and the owner can repoint the token at a new renderer via `setRenderer`.
risks: The renderer is owner-swappable via setRenderer, so the displayed artwork and metadata can be changed at any time.
Centralized roles: the owner controls the hosioi set and the renderer, and the token holder (prophet) controls the mood.

The renderer interpolates hosioi-controlled inputs and providers, prophet-controlled mood, and renderer-owner-controlled configuration into inline JavaScript without escaping. A malicious or compromised role can inject arbitrary code into tokenHTML and animation_url; consumers should sandbox the HTML.
The live piece depends on external RPC endpoints and the scripty.sol contracts to assemble and render, and can break if those change.

storeInputs.title: Store Inputs
storeInputs.description: Record the ERC-20 contracts the oracle watches, logged at the current block. Only the hosioi may call this.

_0.label: inputs
_0.description: JS array literal of the ERC-20 addresses the piece watches.

storeMood.title: Store Mood
storeMood.description: Record the tone knobs that color the oracle's voice, logged at the current block. Only the prophet may call this.

_0.label: mood
_0.description: Pipe-delimited mood / knob values driving the oracle's tone.

storeHttpProviders.title: Store HTTP Providers
storeHttpProviders.description: Set the default HTTP RPC endpoints the live piece reads chain over. Only the hosioi may call this.

_0.label: providers
_0.description: JS array literal of HTTP RPC endpoint URLs.

storeWssProviders.title: Store WSS Providers
storeWssProviders.description: Set the default WebSocket RPC endpoints the live piece reads chain over. Only the hosioi may call this.

_0.label: providers
_0.description: JS array literal of WebSocket (wss) RPC endpoint URLs.

stateAt.title: State At Block
stateAt.description: The inputs and mood in force at a given block, for reconstructing the piece as it stood at that moment.

latestInputs.title: Latest Inputs
latestInputs.description: The most recently stored input contracts and the block at which they were set.

latestMood.title: Latest Mood
latestMood.description: The most recently stored mood values and the block at which they were set.

inputsAt.title: Inputs At Block
inputsAt.description: The input contracts stored exactly at a given block, or empty if none were stored there.

moodAt.title: Mood At Block
moodAt.description: The mood values stored exactly at a given block, or empty if none were stored there.

inputUpdateCount.title: Input Update Count
inputUpdateCount.description: How many distinct blocks contain a stored input snapshot.

moodUpdateCount.title: Mood Update Count
moodUpdateCount.description: How many distinct blocks contain a stored mood snapshot.

tokenHTML.title: View Piece (HTML)
tokenHTML.description: Returns the full self-contained HTML document that renders the piece. Open in a browser to experience it.

prophet.title: Prophet
prophet.description: The current holder of the unique token — the prophet, who alone can set the mood.

isHosioi.title: Is Hosioi
isHosioi.description: Check whether an address is one of the hosioi, permitted to set inputs and RPC endpoints.

renderer.title: Renderer
renderer.description: The renderer contract that builds the token metadata and HTML from the oracle's on-chain state.

httpProvidersJs.title: HTTP Providers
httpProvidersJs.description: The default HTTP RPC endpoints the live piece reads chain over.

wssProvidersJs.title: WSS Providers
wssProvidersJs.description: The default WebSocket RPC endpoints the live piece reads chain over.

setHosioi.title: Set Hosioi
setHosioi.description: Add or remove one of the hosioi. Only the contract owner may call this.

setRenderer.title: Set Renderer
setRenderer.description: Point the token at a new renderer contract. Only the contract owner may call this.
setRenderer.warning: Changing the renderer changes the artwork and metadata the token displays. Verify the new renderer carefully.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The contract owner, who manages the hosioi set and the renderer.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Transfer contract ownership to a new address. Only the current owner may call this.
transferOwnership.warning: The new owner gains full control of the hosioi set and the renderer. This is not the artwork's owner (the prophet).

renounceOwnership.title: Renounce Ownership
renounceOwnership.description: Permanently give up contract ownership, freezing the hosioi set and the renderer.
renounceOwnership.warning: This is irreversible. No one will be able to change the hosioi or the renderer afterward.

InputsStored.title: Inputs Stored
InputsStored.description: Emitted when a hosioi records new input contracts at a block.

MoodStored.title: Mood Stored
MoodStored.description: Emitted when the prophet records a new mood at a block.

HttpProvidersStored.title: HTTP Providers Stored
HttpProvidersStored.description: Emitted when a hosioi sets the default HTTP RPC endpoints.

WssProvidersStored.title: WSS Providers Stored
WssProvidersStored.description: Emitted when a hosioi sets the default WebSocket RPC endpoints.

HosioiSet.title: Hosioi Set
HosioiSet.description: Emitted when an address is added to or removed from the hosioi.

RendererSet.title: Renderer Set
RendererSet.description: Emitted when the renderer contract is changed.
